status: frozen-protocol; no mechanism campaign has run or passed

required_services.postgres: real PostgreSQL, database name ends in _test via FIN_TEST_DSN
required_services.redis: real Redis instance distinct from any development instance
required_services.fencing: barrier-controlled; sleeps alone never establish a race
required_services.artifact_root: injected temporary root; no artifact under the product data paths

denominator_rule: Every case below is required and stays in the mechanism denominator in every campaign. An attempt never removes a case. Missing, blocked, interrupted, not_run, and unscored cases stay countable. A case that passed only after an earlier failed attempt is flaky, which is not a clean pass.
attempt_rule: A retry appends attempt+1 for the same case_id. Logical operations are counted separately from HTTP attempts; the report carries both numbers.
lock_rule: PostgreSQL ownership locks never span external fetch, validation, model/network wait, or indexing.

integration_gates.P3: durable tool outcome ledger (required by M24, M25)
integration_gates.P4: this protocol, the passing lane preflight, and the case/run/report contract
integration_gates.P5: event/outbox delivery (required by M08, M09, M10, M22)
integration_gates.P6: parser adoption/readiness (required by M15, M16, M17, M18, M19, M20, M21, M22)
integration_gates.P7: API/worker lifecycle and cancellation (required by M01, M02, M03, M04, M05, M06, M07, M11, M12, M13, M14, M21, M22, M23, M24)
integration_gates.P10_freeze: only a case that consumes a P10 rubric; none of the cases below declares one

cases.barrier: both API processes accept one operation for the same thread; release both sends after both are accepted
required_observations: exactly one graph owner executes the thread at a time
durable accepted order equals the recorded acceptance order
the second operation does not start before the first terminal commit

cases.barrier: two threads accept an operation; the first thread's worker is held at a barrier while the second runs to completion
required_observations: the second thread reaches terminal state while the first is still held
both threads keep independent operation identity and durable state

cases.barrier: one client intent is submitted twice before any thread ID exists
required_observations: one durable accepted operation exists for the intent
exactly one thread is created
the second HTTP attempt returns the original accepted operation

cases.barrier: the same operation ID and payload is delivered concurrently to both API processes
required_observations: one durable accepted operation and one logical run
HTTP attempt count is greater than the logical operation count
a changed payload under the same ID conflicts instead of creating a second operation

cases.barrier: the response of an accepted operation is dropped; the client retries with the same operation ID
required_observations: the retry converges on the original operation instead of a new run
durable state shows one logical operation

cases.barrier: kill a graph worker after claim, before terminal commit; restart a new worker
required_observations: the restarted worker reclaims the run under a new worker attempt
the killed attempt cannot commit afterwards
durable terminal state is reached exactly once

cases.barrier: after the terminal commit, start a fresh OS process with no prior in-memory state
required_observations: the fresh process reads the accepted operation and terminal message
reconstruction inside the original process is not used as evidence

cases.barrier: hold event publication after the PostgreSQL commit
required_observations: the durable event position is committed before any Redis notification exists
a reader that arrives while publication is held still observes the committed state

cases.barrier: interrupt Redis before and during publication
required_observations: PostgreSQL-backed snapshots still answer
live delivery is reported degraded rather than silently empty
no accepted operation disappears

cases.barrier: leave pending outbox rows, then restore delivery
required_observations: replay republishes each pending notification at least once
duplicate delivery is idempotent at the consumer
the final event position matches the durable position

cases.barrier: expire a worker lease and let a second worker take it over
required_observations: the takeover is recorded as a new worker attempt
only the current owner can advance the run
durable state shows a single owner at the cut point

cases.barrier: release a stale worker after takeover; let it deliver its output
required_observations: the stale output is rejected
the current generation and state are unchanged by the stale worker

cases.barrier: call checkpointer put from an attempt whose lease has been fenced
required_observations: the write is rejected inside the ownership transaction
no checkpoint row is added by the fenced attempt
a missing adapter wiring fails closed instead of writing

cases.barrier: call checkpointer put_writes from an attempt whose lease has been fenced
required_observations: the write is rejected inside the same ownership transaction as put
no checkpoint_write row is added by the fenced attempt

cases.barrier: hold result validation outside the lock; commit a source replacement first
required_observations: the stale result cannot associate with the replaced content
ready is not published for the stale generation

cases.barrier: hold result validation outside the lock; commit a cancellation first
required_observations: adoption rejects the cancelled job
ready is not published for a cancelled job

cases.barrier: hold result validation outside the lock; commit a tombstone deletion first
required_observations: the late result is rejected at adoption and at the ready transaction
the tombstoned object stays deleted

cases.barrier: deliver a parser completion after the caller already adopted a newer result
required_observations: the late completion cannot change the adopted result or readiness
the event is recorded without becoming readiness

cases.barrier: deliver the same parser completion twice
required_observations: the second delivery is idempotent
one adoption transaction commits

cases.barrier: deliver completions out of order relative to job generation
required_observations: only the current generation can reach ready
an older generation is rejected by the generation check

cases.barrier: cancel while a parser worker is still computing
required_observations: the late worker result cannot publish ready
the cancelled state is durable and visible after restart

cases.barrier: crash at each durable cut point; restart and reconcile
required_observations: a pending inbox record reconciles parser-owned status without treating the notification as readiness
each cut point has a durable before/after assertion
Redis presence alone is never read as a business result

cases.barrier: request an absent or tombstoned resource
required_observations: the response is a typed 404
the state is not rendered as retryable failure

cases.barrier: inject a retryable service or storage failure, then a timeout
required_observations: the response stays a retryable 5xx or timeout state
it never becomes false absence, false readiness, or successful completion
an uncertain external effect is reconciled by operation identity before replay

cases.barrier: sample or drop diagnostic spans; toggle the trace exporter off and on; fail the exporter
required_observations: attempt numerators and denominators reproduce from the durable tool outcome ledger
removing spans, UI rows, or receipts does not change any metric
unknown outcomes stay visible and separate from success
a zero eligible denominator reports N/A
a failing exporter does not fail the turn
artifacts carry no credentials, raw environment values, or source content
